patches.name: Fixed powerup spawn rate
patches.note: Forces the powerup pace bag to a constant N pieces (1 powerup per N pieces ~= 100/N %/piece), ignoring the JSON value and Daily-Challenge overrides. Patches both board constructors.

patches.name: Remove on-board powerup cap
patches.note: Removes the per-type on-board powerup limit (FUN_00f4e9dc cur<max gate) so the generator never returns 'no powerup'. Pair with a high spawn rate to saturate the matrix. Turns b.lt into an unconditional branch, skipping the -1.

patches.name: FPS cap (uncap / raise)
patches.note: Raises/removes the native 30fps frame limiter (FUN_00ca2450 @ 0xca2470). Engine is delta-time based, so higher fps is smooth with no speed change. 0 ms = uncapped.

patches.name: Golden cube minos (DarkBlue -> gold)
patches.note: Repoints the DarkBlue single-mino texture to the gold cube (MinoCubeYellow). Any 'n'/dark-blue mino — in finisher matrices AND normal gameplay — renders as a golden cube. Reversible.

patches.name: White cube minos (LightBlue -> white)
patches.note: Repoints the LightBlue single-mino texture to the white cube (MinoCubeWhite). Affects the 'B'/light-blue mino everywhere. Reversible.
